title: Rooms
intro: Rooms let several people share one conversation with a company socio. Each message runs as the person who sent it, and nobody’s private memories or data are shared. With this on, everyone sees Rooms in the sidebar: they create rooms, share a chat as one and invite people. Rooms are a preview.

enable.title: Let members create shared rooms
enable.description: Off by default. Turned off later, rooms and invitations leave the app; a room’s link still opens it read-only, and nothing new runs in it.
enable.saved: Rooms turned on. Everyone sees them in the sidebar.
enable.saved_off: Rooms turned off. Existing rooms are read-only.

budget.title: Members see their room’s use and limits
budget.description: Off by default: only room admins see them. On, everyone in a room sees its limits, its current message’s time and tokens, and the day’s total once at least three people have sent messages. Spend on someone’s own model subscription stays theirs.
budget.saved: Members now see their room’s use and limits
budget.saved_off: Only room admins see a room’s use and limits now

readiness.allPrivate_one: {{count, number}} chat, all private. Turning Rooms on changes none of them.
readiness.allPrivate_other: {{count, number}} chats, all private. Turning Rooms on changes none of them.
readiness.mixed: {{chats}} private, {{rooms}}. Private chats keep their readers either way.
